description: Brand-facing service discovery and detail pages: app/services/page.tsx (browse/filter grid), app/services/[id]/page.tsx (service detail with creator profile). Navigation updates: add 'Browse Services' to main nav for brands, 'My Services' to creator dashboard. Homepage CTA for service discovery. All pages follow existing creators/ page patterns for consistency.
steps: Create app/services/page.tsx following app/creators/page.tsx structure. Public page (no auth required). Header: 'Discover Creator Services' with gradient text. Search bar (searches title/description). Filters sidebar: skills (checkbox list), price range (checkbox list of 5 ranges), delivery time (checkbox list), sort (select: newest, price low/high). Services grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3), service cards match CreatorCard.tsx style: glassmorphism, creator avatar + name in card header, service title (font-semibold), truncated description (2 lines max with line-clamp-2), skills as pill tags (max 4 visible, +N more if overflow), price range badge (gradient bg), delivery time with clock icon, 'View Details' button (gradient hover effect).

Create app/services/[id]/page.tsx for service detail. Fetch service + full creator profile by id. Layout: breadcrumb (Services > Service Title), main content split: left 2/3 - service details section (title, full description, skills grid, price range + delivery time cards, portfolio samples if provided as expandable image/link list), right 1/3 - creator profile card (avatar, name, headline, verification badge, bio truncated, hourly rate, 'View Full Profile' link to /creators/[creatorId], 'Contact Creator' button - links to /messages with pre-filled context or shows 'Login to Contact' if not authenticated, 'Book Service' CTA button with gradient). Style: glass cards, section headers with gradient underline, responsive: stacks vertically on mobile.

Update components/layout/Navbar.tsx: In navLinks array, add new link {href: '/services', label: 'Services', icon: Briefcase} (import Briefcase from lucide-react). Position after 'Discover' and before 'Briefs'. This makes services browsing accessible to all users in main nav.

Add 'My Services' link to creator dashboard sidebar/navigation. Currently dashboard is single page app/dashboard/page.tsx. Two options: (A) Add a client-side tab switcher in dashboard page, or (B) Create nested layout app/dashboard/creator/layout.tsx with sidebar. Simpler approach: add a link card in CreatorDashboard section of app/dashboard/page.tsx, under stats grid, titled 'Manage My Services' with description 'Post and manage your service offerings' and link to /dashboard/creator/services. Style as primary action card similar to brand's 'Post a Brief' card.

Add homepage CTA section for services. In app/page.tsx, add a new section after hero or features: 'Creator Services Marketplace' heading, description 'Discover creators offering ready-to-book services', 2-column grid showing 2 featured services (query GET /api/services?isActive=true&limit=2), 'Browse All Services' button linking to /services. Section style: glass container, gradient heading, service cards in mini format.
